notes: Base Extension Layer. Its egress list is the Base Egress Allowlist; the installer assembles the allowlist file the start-up step consumes (base/egress/start.sh).
A domain also covers all its subdomains. The first domain is used by the start-up self-test, so keep a reliably reachable host first.

Anthropic (anthropic.com, claude.ai, claude.com): verified 2026-10-25 by extracting the URLs embedded in the pinned @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.310 binary: api.anthropic.com, claude.ai and platform.claude.com (OAuth), downloads.claude.ai, mcp-proxy.anthropic.com and docs/status hosts. Re-check when bumping the pin.

OpenAI (openai.com, chatgpt.com): verified the same way against the pinned @openai/codex@0.164.0 binary: api.openai.com, auth.openai.com (login), chatgpt.com (ChatGPT backend). It also embeds auth.api.openai.org and platform.api.openai.org, which are NOT allowed: add openai.org only if login is found to need it.
GitHub: git, API, raw, release assets. VS Code: updates, Marketplace, extension CDN, server download, experiments.
